---
name: Bounded development task
about: One outcome, one owner, explicit dependencies and evidence
---

## Outcome and acceptance

Describe current/desired behavior and how to distinguish success from a plausible result.

## Ownership and scope

Owner/session role, owning repo, branch/worktree, allowed changes and reserved judgments.

## Sources and dependencies

Spec/decision links with revisions, protocol version, affected repos and linked feature/component issues.

## Plan and verification

Small next steps, actual commands/checks, failure cases and required integration evidence. Mark unavailable checks explicitly.

## Progress and handoff

Current state, PR/head, decisions, evidence, unresolved facts and next action. Reconcile with Git on restart.
